 Zubimendi and Merino start: Slavia Prague v Arsenal team news
 Champions League 
 arseblog 
 November 4, 2026 
 25 
 Arsenal are in Champions League action this evening, taking on Slavia Prague away from home.
 Here are today’s official line-ups.
 Slavia Prague : Domchak, Holes, Zima, Kubiak, Sturm, Suleiman, Moses, Ayaosi, Sadilek, Vlcek, Nowak
 Subs : Markovic, Rezek, Chaloupek, N’Guessan, Chytil, Diakite, Kacor, Jurasek, Konecny, Barcot, Kotrba
 Arsenal : Raya, White, Konsa, Gabriel. Hincapie, Rice, Zubimendi, Merino, Madueke, Eze, Gyokeres
 Subs : Kepa, Meslier, Saliba, Mosquera, Timber, Tzolis, Havertz, Calafiori, Odegaard, Guimaraes, Lewis-Skelly, Dowman
